title: Canonical colimit cocone of restricted abelian cohomology
statement: Let X and X₀ be qcqs schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], i:X₀→X a morphism with inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], Λ a finite commutative ring, A a small filtered category of universe u+1, D:A→Sheaf(X_et,Mod Λ) a diagram of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and ι:D→const(F) a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each q≥0, apply module inverse image along i, forget to abelian sheaves, then apply the Ext cohomology functor Sheaf.functorH in degree q [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. The image of the supplied cocone is a colimit cocone of abelian groups, with vertex H^q(X₀,i⁻¹F) and legs H^q(i⁻¹ι_a). No representative is selected in this statement.

proof.text: Forget modules in the supplied colimit cocone; the forgetful functor preserves colimits.

Apply abelian inverse image, which preserves colimits. The natural compatibility with module inverse image identifies the resulting cocone, including each leg, with the underlying abelian restrictions of ι_a.

Choose a final directed reindexing by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-exists-directed-final], realized by Mathlib IsFiltered.exists_directed; clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-directed-cofinal] describes the reindexed colimit cocone. Retain universe u+1. The proof of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-filtered-colimit] works at that size: finite qcqs covers make sections commute with filtered colimits, giving degree zero. Embed the diagram functorially into injectives and take its cokernel diagram. Filtered colimits are exact. The finite-cover Cech complex of the colimit of injectives is the filtered colimit of their exact augmented Cech complexes. The Cech vanishing criterion makes this colimit acyclic on every qcqs object. Comparing the two long exact sequences gives degree one as a cokernel of sections, and each higher degree by dimension shifting to the preceding degree of the cokernel diagram; induction applies simultaneously to all diagrams. Only finite upper bounds are used, not a bound of u on the index. For the final functor F, clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-initial-functor-cofiltered-criterion], applied to F.op, identifies the canonical colimits; Mathlib Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv reflects colimithood of the directed image cocone to A. The natural [lem-weil-pbc-sheafH-ext-derived-comparison] identifies the functor and every leg with Sheaf.functorH and Sheaf.H.map. No element representative is selected.

theorem restrictedCohomology_isColimit
    {X X₀ : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X₀] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀] (i : X₀ ⟶ X)
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory A] [IsFiltered A]
    {D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    {F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F)
    (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)))
    (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit
      (((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ] ⋙
        sheafCompose X₀.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH X₀.smallEtaleTopology q).mapCocone (Cocone.mk F ι)))
